title: zereight-review finding record
description: Minimum shape for zer verify. Array items may also be strings of the form file:line or file:line:old. Enforced by zer/src/verify.rs. Severity, if present, maps to skill marks: critical=red, major=orange, minor=yellow, trivial=blue, info=white, refactor=wrench.

file.description: Repo-relative path, must appear in the manifest

line.description: New-file line, or old-file line when side=old
